title: Unhandled BPMN Error Event & Parallel Deadlock SOP
summary: Standard operating playbook for resolving unhandled BPMN error throw events, missing error boundaries, and downstream parallel join deadlocks.
root_cause_template: Task '{task_name}' ({element_id}) threw a business error (code: '{error_code}') which was not caught in the active execution scope. {topology_hazard}
recommended_actions: Add an Error Boundary Catch Event with errorCode '{error_code}' to the '{task_name}' task boundary in Camunda Modeler.

If the failing task is inside a Parallel Fork, route the error sequence flow to a Terminate End Event or attach an interrupting Error Boundary Event to the parent subprocess scope to prevent downstream token starvation deadlocks.
Investigate upstream service logs ({service}) to resolve the root infrastructure or business exception triggering the error throw.
Redeploy the updated BPMN XML to Zeebe and retry the incident in Camunda Operate.

title: Database Connection Pool Saturation & Lock Contention SOP
summary: Remediation procedures for HikariCP database connection pool exhaustion, connection leaks, and PostgreSQL row lock contention.
root_cause_template: Database connection pool saturated in {service}. Applications timed out after {timeout_ms}ms waiting for an available connection due to long-running transactions and connection pool starvation.
recommended_actions: Run 'SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != ''idle'' AND wait_event_type = ''Lock''' in PostgreSQL to identify blocking row lock transactions.
Terminate long-running uncommitted transactions using 'SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)' for sessions older than 30s.
Scale maximum HikariCP pool size in service configuration (e.g. increase spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size from 50 to 100).
Enable leak detection in connection pool settings: spring.datasource.hikari.leak-detection-threshold=5000ms.
Restart the affected worker service containers and resume suspended instances in Camunda Operate.

title: BPMN Gateway Condition Evaluation Failure SOP
summary: Playbook for resolving exclusive (XOR) or inclusive gateway condition expression failures and unhandled routing branches.
root_cause_template: Gateway '{gateway_name}' failed to evaluate any outgoing sequence flow conditions to true given runtime variables. No default sequence flow was defined.
recommended_actions: Inspect outgoing sequence flow FEEL condition expressions on the failing gateway '{gateway_name}' in Camunda Modeler.
Verify runtime variable values against condition expressions (check for missing or null variables).
Add defensive null-checks in FEEL expressions: if is defined(varName) and varName != null then (condition) else false.
Always configure a Default Sequence Flow on the XOR gateway to prevent unhandled routing stalls.
Deploy the corrected BPMN model and resolve the incident in Camunda Operate.

title: DMN Decision Table Evaluation & FEEL Runtime Type Error SOP
summary: Procedures for diagnosing and fixing DMN decision table evaluation errors, missing input clauses, and FEEL runtime type mismatches.
root_cause_template: DMN decision table evaluation failed at '{task_name}' due to missing, null, or type-incompatible input variables.
recommended_actions: Open the DMN model and inspect all input clause expressions for required variable dependencies.
Verify upstream worker tasks are properly populating required input variables prior to DMN evaluation.
Add default fallback rows in the DMN decision table (e.g. catch-all rule with default score for null/unknown inputs).
Validate input data formats and implement defensive FEEL type conversions (e.g. number(score)).
Deploy updated DMN decision to Zeebe and retry the incident in Camunda Operate.

title: User Task Form Registry Binding & Missing Schema SOP
summary: Remediation guide for user tasks failing to render due to missing form schemas or invalid form binding IDs in the Camunda Form Registry.
root_cause_template: User task '{task_name}' referenced formId '{form_id}' which does not exist in the active Camunda Form registry.
recommended_actions: In Camunda Modeler, inspect the user task '{task_name}' and verify the linked formId / formKey.
Deploy the matching .form JSON schema file alongside the BPMN process to Zeebe.
Check the Camunda Tasklist and Zeebe form registry to confirm the schema version matches runtime compatibility.
Once the form schema is deployed, retry the blocked user task instance in Camunda Operate.

title: Kafka Producer Delivery Timeout & Broker Partition Loss SOP
summary: Procedures for Kafka producer delivery timeouts, partition leader reconnects, and event buffer saturation recovery.
root_cause_template: Kafka producer in {service} failed to deliver records within timeout window due to broker disconnect or partition leader re-election.
recommended_actions: Verify Kafka cluster health and broker availability using 'kafka-broker-api-versions.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092'.
Inspect topic partition leadership and ISR list: 'kafka-topics.sh --describe --topic {topic_name}'.
Ensure min.insync.replicas is satisfied and healthy brokers are online.
Tune producer timeout resilience: delivery.timeout.ms=180000 and max.block.ms=30000.
Resume event bridge worker processing and retry the failed task in Camunda Operate.

title: Upstream HTTP 5xx Gateway Outage & Worker Retries Exhaustion SOP
summary: Remediation guide for upstream 5xx errors, exhausted worker retries (JOB_NO_RETRIES), and circuit breaker failover.
root_cause_template: External upstream service returned HTTP {status_code} error to {service}. Automated retries were exhausted, suspending the Zeebe job.
recommended_actions: Check upstream provider status page and inspect worker logs for response payloads and error codes.
Implement a Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j / Envoy) to fail fast and trigger automated fallback workflows.
Once upstream service recovers, increment incident retries (e.g. set retries=3) in Camunda Operate.
Resolve the incident in Camunda Operate to allow the job worker to re-execute.

title: FEEL Variable Extraction & Undefined Scope Resolution SOP
summary: Playbook for diagnosing FEEL variable extraction errors and undefined property access in task scopes.
root_cause_template: FEEL expression failed to extract property '{property_name}' because the variable is null or missing in the current execution scope.
recommended_actions: Identify the failing FEEL expression and inspect variable scope at the failure element in Camunda Operate.
Verify upstream worker tasks are correctly creating the required payload variables.
Use null-coalescing expressions in FEEL mappings: if myVar != null then myVar else 'default'.
Redeploy the BPMN model and retry the incident in Camunda Operate.

title: BPMN Task Input/Output Variable Mapping Failure SOP
summary: Standard operating procedure for resolving task input and output variable mapping failures and type mismatches.
root_cause_template: Input/Output variable mapping failed on '{task_name}'. Source expression could not be evaluated or target variable type was incompatible.
recommended_actions: Open the task in Camunda Modeler and inspect the Input/Output variable mappings.
Ensure all source variables exist in the instance scope before the task executes.
Validate data types between source expressions and target variables.
Redeploy the BPMN model and retry the incident in Camunda Operate.

title: Redis Connection Pool Saturation & Cluster Timeout SOP
summary: Remediation guide for Lettuce/Jedis Redis connection pool timeouts, Redis cluster node failover, and memory eviction deadlocks.
root_cause_template: Redis connection timeout in {service}. Worker timed out after {timeout_ms}ms attempting to acquire a connection to the Redis cluster.
recommended_actions: Inspect Redis cluster node health: 'redis-cli -h {redis_host} -p {redis_port} cluster nodes'.
Check memory usage and eviction rate: 'redis-cli info memory'. If maxmemory is exceeded, adjust maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru.
Increase client pool size (e.g. lettuce.pool.max-active=50) and command timeout (timeout=5000ms).
Restart degraded client worker pods to re-establish clean connection pool channels.
